name: Kaloyan
line: I set the direction, approve every spec and implementation brief, and decide what ships.
owns: The final say on what ships
replay: Asked for a page that introduces the crew.

line: I run a feature end to end: classify the request, get a spec, write the implementation brief, hand it to the right implementer, then verify the result.
replay: Classified it as a feature spanning frontend and devops. Calling spec-writer.

line: I turn a feature request into one numbered spec in specs/. Nobody writes code until I have.
I build what the spec describes under src/, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, strictly by DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.
replay: Built the agents template, agents.css and agents.js.

line: I keep the pipeline running: GitHub Actions workflows, GitHub Pages publishing, the CNAME and the build script. I stay out of src/.
replay: Taught the build to generate /agents/ from the definitions in .claude/.

line: I test browser-visible changes on the locally served site with Playwright, at desktop and phone sizes. I report; I never edit files.
replay: Tested the page at desktop and phone sizes and filed a report.

line: I add a dated entry to CHANGELOG.md for every shipped feature, filed under Added, Changed or Removed.
replay: Logged the Agents page under Added in CHANGELOG.md.

line: I draft and edit posts in Kaloyan's voice as markdown in src/blog/posts/, and I never invent experiences or results.
I check a post's on-page SEO (title, summary, slug, headings, links and alt text) and suggest fixes. I only apply them when asked.
owns: SEO findings and suggested fixes for posts

line: I'm the conversational front door to spec-writer: I gather your request, relay its questions and iterate until the spec is final. I don't build.
I hand a page or feature scope to the ui-qa agent and pass its report back to you unchanged.
